description: This PHP class 'FieldOperator' defines an operator used in JSON API filters within the SuiteCRM project. It extends a base 'Operator' class and provides methods for validating and converting filter operators, specifically handling operator syntax and validation logic.

classes.name: FieldOperator
classes.description: A class representing a filter operator with validation and formatting capabilities in SuiteCRM's JSON API filtering system.

methods.name: toFilterTag
methods.description: Converts an operator to its filter tag representation by delegating to the parent class.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Checks if the provided operator string is valid according to the parent class's rules, throws exception if input is not a string.

methods.name: isOperator
methods.description: Determines if the given string is a valid operator, with type validation.

methods.name: totalOperands
methods.description: Returns the total number of operands expected after the operator, which is 0 for this class.
